fields.description: A patch-package patch (patches/foliate-js+1.0.1.patch) makes foliate-js's View.destroy() and Paginator.destroy() call this.#observer.disconnect(). The leaked observers on dead section bodies stop flooding error.log (14,428 lines a session on the base, 0 after). Smoke 2026-10-26 F15 repeats the ResizeObserver flood on release36ac7466. Keep with BUG-187 and this held fix; verify on integrated candidate. No proven causal link to completed-read visibility.
